faqs.q: Sec. 102-74. - Common ownership of water meters and service lines.
faqs.a:
(a)
Should any water meter or water or sewer service line serve two or more properties
               or structures that are separately owned, such water or sewer service will for all
               purposes be treated as common owners. Common owners will be jointly and severally
               responsible for all service charges and other responsibilities of ownership and are
               equally entitled to receive water or sewer service.
(b)
In the event that the city determines that the common owners have failed to pay any
               water or sewer bill or failed to maintain service lines, the city may require that
               separate connections be made. In such event, the requirement of
section 102-75
(b) applies.
(Code 1981, § 33-45; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988)
